mapping: Use one reviewed source line. All GitHub-shaped IDs, commit, scope and timestamps in the local envelope are synthetic contract adapters, never original metadata. Map to BUILD as an analysis-stage interpretation.
execution_policy: Local deterministic only; no provider calls or authorized external-model processing

cases.source_annotation: Mix formatting gate rejected unformatted source.
cases.independent_confirmation: Developer confirmed the extracted passage in the dataset cross-validation; no independent upstream root cause established
cases.reference_limit: The gate failure is observed; the cause of formatting drift is unknown.
cases.sanitization: Remove ANSI and CR; omit file list and surrounding output.

cases.source_annotation: Compilation stopped when a required header could not be found.
cases.independent_confirmation: Developer confirmed the extracted passage in the dataset cross-validation; no independent upstream root cause established
cases.reference_limit: The excerpt does not distinguish a missing SDK, include-path configuration, or incompatible host.
cases.sanitization: Remove source path, line and column, CR, and surrounding output.

cases.source_annotation: A timeout-wrapped build command exited with status 124.
cases.independent_confirmation: Developer confirmed the extracted passage in the dataset cross-validation; no independent upstream root cause established
cases.reference_limit: Consistent with a timeout; the cause of the delay is unknown and the status alone cannot establish it.
cases.sanitization: Remove Travis timing telemetry, ANSI and surrounding output; retain public build command and exit status as inert text.
